text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the staff at Boulder Falls for their attentiveness, patience, and warmth when greeting pets at drop-off. Multiple reviewers highlight named employees such as Melissa and Tatiana for going out of their way to reassure anxious owners. Clients appreciate that team members maintain great patience with high-energy dogs as well as senior pets.

Reviewers emphasize how thoughtfully the facility handles dogs and cats with distinct needs, including blind, diabetic, or skittish rescues. Clients note that staff happily manage complex medication schedules and allow familiar blankets from home to ease transitions. Boarded animals return home relaxed and well-fed after supervised play.

Many clients highlight the grooming salon for leaving pets looking and smelling exceptional. Reviews frequently mention thorough baths, smooth fur with mats completely cleared, gentle nail trims, and fresh breath after dental cleanings. Dog and cat owners express satisfaction with the skilled care provided to coats of all textures.

q.en: Can pets receive grooming during their boarding stay?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently arrange for baths, full hair trims, nail clippings, and teeth brushing while their pets are boarded.

q.en: Does Boulder Falls accommodate pets requiring daily medication?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report that the team reliably administers required oral medications, including routines for diabetic pets.

q.en: Can owners bring personal bedding or blankets from home?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate that the facility allows familiar blankets to help shy or anxious animals feel secure during their visit.

q.en: Are phone updates available while pets are boarded?

a.en: Yes, several clients note that they called the facility during their trips and received prompt, reassuring updates on their pets.
